oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created INV-2026-2234008456 - spike in inference-p95 and error-rate on inference-pool-us-west. Pager routed to rotation: Priya K (primary), Marcus B (secondary). Automated alert flood at 22:07 UTC. See incident ticket: https://incidents.redwood/internal/INV-2234008456
Priya K: I'm on it. getting a lot of p95 pages. dashboard shows a strong tail around 1.2s for a subset of hosts. looks correlated with a canary deploy started ~22:00.
Marcus B: seeing same. root cause looks like increased kv-cache misses due to model variant change in canary. logs show evictions and slow cold-starts for kv shards.
Priya K: paging noise is high; can we temporarily relax the p95 alert window while we mitigate so we don't page everyone repeatedly?
Elena R: incoming handoff in ~25m. we should document any threshold change in the incident. if we bump window, keep to a minimal safe delta and set auto-revert.
Priya K: agreed. proposal: p95 latency alert threshold change: 300ms -> 450ms for 10 minutes; error-rate alert suppression 5m -> 10m for the same window. set an automated rollback at +15m. this prevents cascading pagers but still keeps customer-impacting failures paged. ok?
Marcus B: +1. also add a temporary mute for non-prod targets and keep production pages active. runbook says to prefer mutation of monitor via API so history is tracked.
Priya K: doing the monitor update now. command (Datadog):
```
curl -X PUT "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/monitor/812345" \
  -H "DD-API-KEY: $DD_API_KEY" -H "DD-APPLICATION-KEY: $DD_APP_KEY" \
  -d '{"options":{"thresholds":{"critical":450}}, "message":"TEMPORARY: raised p95 threshold during mitigation, auto-revert in 15m - INV-2234008456"}'
```
Priya K: applied the change and added a note to the incident ticket. Monitor id 812345 now shows the temporary note.
oncall-bot: Monitor 812345 updated by Priya K. Change comment: "TEMPORARY: raised p95 threshold during mitigation, auto-revert in 15m - INV-2234008456"
Marcus B: also pushed a short suppression rule for alert route /eng-oncall to avoid alert storm to the whole rotation:
```
# ops-bot suppression (example)
ops-bot suppress add --target eng-oncall --monitor 812345 --duration 10m --reason "mitigation for KV cache eviction during canary" --auto-revert 15m
```
ops-bot: Suppression created: sup-5678 for monitor 812345; will auto-revert at +15m.
Elena R: copying runbook pointer for anyone joining: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-eviction - section "temporary threshold changes". steps: validate canary rollbacks, check kv-miss rate, verify p50/p95 return to baseline.
Priya K: mitigation steps taken: 1) roll back canary to previous model variant on 2 hosts, 2) increase kv cache size on canary hosts (hotfix), 3) temporary p95 bump and suppression in Datadog.
Marcus B: logs snippet showing evictions (tail):
```
2026-05-14T22:03:02Z [kv-shard-07] eviction_count=342 delta=+112 miss_ratio=0.48 model_variant=canary-1.3
2026-05-14T22:04:10Z [kv-shard-09] cold_start=1 latency_ms=870 op=get
```
Marcus B: after the rollback, p95 dropped back to ~260ms within 4m on canary hosts. overall error-rate trending down.
Priya K: marking customer impact as "limited" (small percentage of requests, increased latency but not failed). updating incident status.
Elena R: incoming handoff note: i'll be primary for next 8h. Marcus you remain secondary through my shift. please confirm coverage for APAC overlap 06:00 UTC.
Marcus B: confirmed. i'll watch the revert window and metric drift for the first 30m post-revert.
Priya K: handing off now. full handoff checks in the ticket: actions performed, monitors modified (812345), suppression sup-5678, rollback performed on canary hosts, runbook referenced.
Elena R: thanks. i'll track for 60m after auto-revert, if we see re-escalation i'll re-open the incident and page Marcus. also will post a short post-incident note when stable.
oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: Priya K -> Elena R at 22:19 UTC. Primary: Elena R, Secondary: Marcus B. Incident INV-2234008456 remains active.
Elena R: quick checklist for next steps: 1) ensure suppression auto-revert happened at +15m (ops-bot will log it), 2) confirm Datadog monitor thresholds restored, 3) run a quick smoke test against inference-pool-us-west.
ops-bot: Suppression sup-5678 auto-reverted at 22:34 UTC. Monitor 812345 threshold restored to 300ms. Change comment: auto-revert by ops-bot for INV-2234008456.
Marcus B: verified restored thresholds and p95 steady at 280ms across the pool. no new pages in the last 12m.
Elena R: closing note here: we executed minimal threshold bump to reduce noise during mitigations, set auto-revert to avoid drift, documented everything in INV-2234008456, and will include a short blameless postmortem covering why the canary caused kv evictions.
Priya K: thanks team. good handoff. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident INV-2234008456 moved to "monitoring" state. If metrics stay stable for 1h, set to resolved.
